generated.script: Using Q-Dir or DesktopOK? Your computer might be compromised right now! Hackers infiltrated the official SoftwareOK website, tampering with installation files for both Q-Dir and DesktopOK. This means when you downloaded or even updated these popular tools, you might have received dangerous remote access malware instead. This was a sophisticated software supply chain attack targeting unsuspecting users. Immediately uninstall Q-Dir and DesktopOK from your system. Verify official channels for clean versions or consider alternatives before reinstalling any software from SoftwareOK.

slides.body: Cybersecurity researchers have revealed a software supply chain attack targeting Q-Dir and DesktopOK. Malicious files were found within the official installation files distributed via the SoftwareOK website. This compromise affected users downloading the programs directly and those updating previously installed versions. Users unknowingly installing these tampered files risk delivering remote access malware to their systems.
